card.line: Magog is a northern land ruled by Gog. In Ezekiel, God speaks against it, and in Revelation its name stands for nations that gather against God's people.

moments.title: God speaks against Gog
moments.text: God tells Ezekiel to set his face against Gog of the land of Magog and to prophesy against him. God says He will bring Gog out with all his army.

moments.title: Fire on Magog
moments.text: God says He will send fire on Magog and on those who live securely in the coastlands. Then they will know that He is the LORD.

moments.title: Gog and Magog gather for battle
moments.text: After the thousand years, Satan goes out to deceive the nations, Gog and Magog, and gathers them for battle. Fire comes down from heaven and consumes them.
